Atlantic Ocean Currents and Coral Reefs Show Signs of Recovery

A study indicates that Atlantic Ocean currents, which have experienced severe climate weakening, possess the capacity to recover. Separately, research has found that bleached coral can rebound after coming into contact with healthy coral.
